action: If you are a Hood River Dental patient, check card and bank statements, consider a credit freeze, and take up any monitoring offered in your notice letter.
exec: Small-practice breach with sensitive financial and identity data and a long gap between incidents and confirmation.
plain: An Oregon dental practice says two separate hacks exposed personal, financial and medical details of more than 31,000 patients.
summary: The practice disclosed two separate security incidents, one identified on or around October 22, 2025 and one occurring on or around January 15, 2026, and confirmed on September 8, 2026 that patient data was exposed. They affect 16,609 and 14,677 people, 31,286 in total. Data includes Social Security and driver's licence numbers, payment card and financial account details, diagnoses and insurance information.
title: Oregon's Hood River Dental reports two breaches affecting more than 31,000 patients

validation.note: One trade outlet; the total is the sum of the two incident counts it reports.

review.note: Counts 16,609 and 14,677 match HIPAA Journal; added 31,286 total to summary, fixed second incident to 'occurring on or around' Jan 15 2026 and Sept 8 2026 year
